page.overview:
Who is Goss?

Goss was a Human male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire. During the Cold War with the Galactic Republic, he was present at a party on Kaas City, the same party that Lord Zash attended to cover up her trace of planning Darth Skotia's assassination, which her apprentice eventually executed.
